title: How to read a floor plan in five minutes
excerpt: Photographs are chosen to flatter. A floor plan cannot lie about where the bathroom is. What to look for before you book a viewing.
content:
Photographs are chosen to flatter. A floor plan cannot lie about where the bathroom is, how far the kitchen is from the table, or whether the third bedroom is a cupboard.

Three things to check

  • Which way the main rooms face
  • How you walk from the front door to the kitchen
  • Whether any room is only reached through another

A good plan is one you can walk through in your head without getting lost.

Every home we list has a measured plan. If something on it is unclear, ask before the viewing rather than during it.
